# What the data-dict export loses: General Social Survey

The YAML files here follow data-dict spec 0.1.0. They describe the common data format, so they validate against its parquet files. The records in `metadata/` remain canonical. This table counts what the export drops or flattens into text.

| | `7224r3a` | `7224r3` |
|---|---|---|
| variables exported | 50 | 50 |
| variables whose numeric code labels went to `details` (no labeled numeric codes) | 47 | 47 |
| missing or unresolved codes, typed only in the `__code` column's labels | 182 | 182 |
| availability entries (wave by form, with n), summarized as one line of text | 2,871 | 2,871 |
| corrections applied; only the corrected text is exported | 4 | 4 |
| field origins (publisher, data file, rule, hand, model) not exported | 308 | 308 |
| groups (batteries, subjects, sections), not exported | 25 | 25 |
| links between releases, not exported | 50 | 50 |
| derived properties (scale signatures), not exported | 27 | 27 |
| release id not expressible as data-dict `version` (needs semver or a date) | 1 | 1 |
